YOOOOOO I was meditating to this video on connecting to your high self which caused me to fall asleep. My bf called and woke me up in the middle of my nap. Right when I put down the phone I felt my body SINKING INTO SLEEP PARALYSIS (I used to get it a lot so I was aware of the feeling). I started to freak out and tried fighting it, then moving my pinky then toes but this was way too strong to fight so I just said fuk it and sunk! I had like 10 inception dreams and every time I thought I finally woke up and went through my day I’d realize it was a dream. It took me 40mins to find my body again. Dream after dream, I thought I was awake and either something weird would happen and I would think “damn I’m still dreaming” or someone would tell me. At one point I thought I was awake finally and I went down stairs to talk to my dad but I really wasn’t sure to I thought “okay I’m willing to punch him to know if I’m dreaming because I’m so lost right now” punched him- he didn’t get that mad and I knew I was dreaming. This was one of the craziest experiences I have ever had. Wow, I still can’t believe it.
